product: MonsoonIQ — regime-aware post-processing of NWP rainfall

provenance_detail.note: Observations: IMD 0.25 deg daily gridded rainfall (Pai et al. 2014, IMD Pune). Forecasts: NOAA GFS 00 UTC runs (AWS Open Data noaa-gfs-bdp-pds), Day 1-5. District boundaries: DataMeet Census-2011 (CC BY 2.5 IN). GFS stands in for NCMRWF NCUM, which is not publicly downloadable.
provenance_detail.disclaimer: Real data: IMD 0.25 deg gridded rainfall observations and NOAA GFS forecasts. Research prototype - not an official IMD/NCMRWF product.
provenance_detail.what_is_real: Observed rainfall (IMD Pune, Pai et al. 2014), raw Day 1-5 forecasts and dynamical predictors (NOAA GFS 00 UTC via AWS Open Data), district boundaries (Census 2011, DataMeet), every metric and interval.
provenance_detail.what_is_synthetic: Nothing in the data. Regime labels are derived by objective rules (configs/regime_labels_real.yaml); GFS stands in for NCMRWF NCUM.

regimes.name: Active Monsoon
regimes.criterion: core-monsoon-zone IMD rainfall >= +1 SD for 3+ days, Jul-Aug (Rajeevan et al. 2010)

regimes.name: Break Monsoon
regimes.criterion: core-monsoon-zone IMD rainfall <= -1 SD for 3+ days, Jul-Aug (Rajeevan et al. 2010)

regimes.name: Monsoon Low / Depression
regimes.criterion: GFS MSLP >= 4 hPa below normal and 850 hPa vorticity >= 4e-5 s-1, 15-26N 78-92E

regimes.name: Orographic
regimes.criterion: 850 hPa westerlies >= 12 m/s onto the Ghats and West Coast rainfall >= +1 SD

regimes.name: Coastal
regimes.criterion: East Coast district rainfall >= +1 SD without a low

regimes.name: Western Disturbance
regimes.criterion: 500 hPa height over NW India >= 35 gpm below normal

known_limits: Raw forecasts are NOAA GFS 0.5 deg, a public stand-in for NCMRWF NCUM; skill against NCUM will differ.
Five monsoon seasons (2021-2025) only: models are fitted on 2021-2022, tuned on 2023 and verified on 2024-2025.
Regime labels are objective day-level criteria (configs/regime_labels_real.yaml), not IMD's operational synoptic analysis.
District rainfall is aggregated from IMD 0.25 deg gridded data over Census-2011 boundaries; station-scale extremes are smoothed.
Rapid cyclogenesis and sub-kilometre orographic extremes are unresolved.
